title: ICEFISH DASH
oneLiner: Slide through icy waters, scoop up fish, and weave past snapping seals.
hook: Commit to a slippery line: staying on a fast slide collects fish efficiently, but braking or steering early is safer when seals block the route.
ramp: Each run has four short scrolling ice fields with authored teach, build, peak, and recovery sections. The first field presents isolated fish and one slow seal; later fields add staggered seal patrols,
mechanics: The penguin automatically slides forward across connected ice floes; Left and Right steer, while releasing both directions preserves momentum.
Press A to brake briefly, reducing speed and allowing a sharper turn; braking has a 0.6-second recovery before it can be used again.
Fish are collected on contact and score once; the first fish is placed directly on the opening route so the goal is immediately readable.
Seals patrol marked ice lanes. They pause with a warning bark for 0.35 seconds, then lunge across their lane; touching a seal or leaving the ice costs one life.
A seal lunge can be dodged by steering to another lane or braking before the crossing. Successful near-misses within 12 pixels award a 50-point precision bonus once per lunge.
Collecting fish without missing one builds a chain multiplier up to x4; missing a fish or losing a life resets the chain. Each fish scores 100 times the current multiplier.
Cracked ice is a visual warning and collapses only after the penguin crosses it; crossing costs momentum and forces a short recovery, while falling off the bottom or side costs a life.
Each field ends at a bright igloo gate after 20 to 28 fish placements. Reaching it advances the stage; stage four ends the run with a results screen.

The opening section has one slow seal and wide lanes, later sections add staggered patrols, narrow floes, and at most three simultaneous seals. Every field includes a quiet recovery stretch after its peak.
The penguin has three lives. On loss, freeze for 0.8 seconds, show the collision cause and knockback, then restart the current field at its checkpoint with its fish placements reset.
artDirection: 256x224 single-screen viewport with horizontal scrolling. The penguin is a 24x28 pixel black-and-white sprite with a round white belly, orange beak and feet, blue scarf, and distinct upright idle, crouched sliding, turning, and hurt poses. Fish are 10x7 bright cyan-and-gold sprites with a clear sparkle. Seals are 24x16 pale-gray sprites with dark noses and flippers; their raised-head warning pose precedes a lunge. Use deep navy ice shadows, pale-blue platforms, white snow, and warm orange pickups against a quiet layered polar background: distant mountains, midground ice floes, and foreground cracks. Keep hazards and fish high-contrast and reserve the brightest highlights for pickups and impact flashes.

controls.left: Steer the sliding penguin left; active during play and recovery movement.
controls.right: Steer the sliding penguin right; active during play and recovery movement.
controls.a: Brake and turn sharply while sliding; usable during play, with a 0.6-second cooldown.

lose: The run ends when all three lives are lost; falling or colliding with a seal costs one life.
scoring: Fish score 100 points times the current x1–x4 chain multiplier, and a clean seal near-miss scores 50 points.
